description: The pie chart shows the proportional distribution of different dialogue state tracking slot categories, with 14 slices in total, each labeled with a percentage. The largest slice is labeled “date, 19.30%” and is colored medium green, followed by “from, 17.00%” in light blue, “to, 14.50%” in yellow, and “genre, 13.50%” in dark green; mid-sized slices include “name, 5.20%” in dark blue and “size, 4.20%” in brown. Smaller slices are “intent, 3.80%” in light blue, “location, 3.80%” in gray-green, “destination, 3.00%” in green, “city, 2.60%” in blue, “class, 2.40%” in orange, “range, 2.20%” in light green, “type, 2.00%” in light blue, “beds, 1.30%” in pale yellow, and “passengers, 1.10%” in very dark green. Percentages are printed directly on or next to slices with leader lines for the smaller segments, there is no separate legend, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller around the chart.
